# EdgeWeb — Full Company & Service Reference

## Company Overview

EdgeWeb (legal name: EdgeWeb Infotech LLP) is a web development agency, custom software development agency and AI automation agency founded in 2019 and based in Vishwas Nagar, Delhi 110032, India, operating remote-first for clients in Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad), the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia and across India — including all 28 Indian states and 8 union territories. EdgeWeb's positioning statement is: "Technology should remove complexity — not relocate it." The company positions itself as a single full-stack partner rather than a fragmented vendor stack, serving both early-stage teams that need one product built well and established businesses that need system integration or replacement.

Contact: info@edgeweb.co | +91 92667 26490 (also WhatsApp) | linkedin.com/company/edgeweb
Office: Vishwas Nagar, Delhi 110032, India

## How EdgeWeb Works (process)

EdgeWeb describes a six-stage engagement process:

1. Identify the actual business challenge (not a feature list)
2. Architecture planning before any code is written
3. Technology selection appropriate to the problem
4. Implementation, including automation where useful
5. AI integration where it adds real value
6. Measuring business outcomes, not just delivery

Typical engagement length is 6–16 weeks depending on scope, delivered in phases so clients see a working system early rather than a single release at the end. Most clients maintain a support or iteration arrangement after launch. Code and intellectual property belong to the client once a project is paid in full.

## Industries served

Retail & distribution, financial services, healthcare, consumer brands & e-commerce, furniture retail, recycling & SaaS, EV charging & smart infrastructure, and travel & visa services — evidenced by delivered projects (see Case Studies below). EdgeWeb also serves early-stage/startup teams across other sectors building a first product.

All case studies: https://www.edgeweb.co/case-studies

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does EdgeWeb actually build?
A: Custom web and mobile applications, process automation, applied AI, cloud infrastructure and the data layer connecting them — plus the digital marketing to bring the right traffic once it's live.

Q: Is EdgeWeb a web development agency, a custom software development agency, or an AI automation agency?
A: All three. EdgeWeb is a single full-stack team covering web development, custom software development and AI automation, rather than three separate specialists — most client engagements combine more than one of these.

Q: How does a project usually start?
A: Projects begin with discussions about actual business problems rather than feature lists, followed by architecture planning before coding begins. A free 30-minute consultation is available at https://www.edgeweb.co/consultation.

Q: Do you work with early-stage businesses, or only established ones?
A: EdgeWeb serves both early-stage teams needing a single product built well and established businesses requiring system integration or replacement.

Q: What's the typical engagement length?
A: Most builds run 6–16 weeks depending on scope, scoped in phases so a working system ships early.

Q: Do you offer support after launch?
A: Yes — most clients maintain a support or iteration arrangement post-launch.

Q: Where is EdgeWeb based, and do you work with clients outside India?
A: EdgeWeb is based in Delhi, India, and serves both local and international clients — the USA, UK, Europe, Australia and across India — through remote-first delivery.

Full FAQ: https://www.edgeweb.co/faq
